summary: BBVA files a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchase transactions executed under the third tranche of its buyback program. Between May 25–29, 2026, the bank purchased 5,281,752 shares at a weighted average price of roughly €20.01, for total cash spent of approximately €447.9 million (about 30.68% of the third tranche's maximum). The buyback is being managed by Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG. No tender offer, privatization, or special distribution is involved. This is a routine capital return program update, not a special situation.
